synthesizedFacts.fact: Dry skin in winter is primarily caused by low humidity levels both indoors and outdoors, which leads to increased water loss from the skin.
Moisturizers that contain humectants, emollients, and occlusives are effective in treating dry skin by attracting moisture, filling spaces between skin cells, and sealing in moisture.
Hot showers can exacerbate dry skin by stripping natural oils from the skin surface.
Using a humidifier indoors can help maintain skin hydration by adding moisture to the air.
